title: Fix CPU frequency locked at 400MHz on HP EliteBook 845 G10
summary: On HP EliteBook 845 G10 with AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 7840HS, the CPU may lock to 400-544MHz when unplugged from AC power. Blacklisting the amd_pmf module fixes this.

aliases.text: hp elitebook cpu slow on battery

prerequisites: HP EliteBook 845 G10 with AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 7840HS

steps.explain: Create a modprobe configuration file to blacklist the amd-pmf module.
Reboot the system to apply the module blacklist.

rollback.explain: Remove the blacklist entry from /etc/modprobe.d/cpufreq.conf and reboot.

warnings: This disables the AMD Platform Management Framework, which may affect other power management features.
